recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-6137. Handle any later Consent example quality or search-parameter coverage trackers separately rather than reopening the original no-examples issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6137 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CBCC change request from DSTU1 asking for examples for Consent. Its final resolution said no action was needed because Consent now has many examples.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-6137 was found. Consent examples appear to have been added and maintained through broader Consent work, including the 2016 Consent resource prototype/example commits and later example updates such as the 2018 current-model corrections, 2019 example rework, and 2021 search-example additions.
additional_context: FHIR-6285 supplied the BPPC/simple-consent use cases referenced in FHIR-6137 comments and was also marked Published/Persuasive as already applied. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Consent as an active, approved resource, and source/consent/list-Consent-examples.xml lists 14 Consent example entries. Later Consent-example quality issues exist, but they are separate coverage or typo questions and are not needed to decide this absence-of-examples issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already contains a Consent examples list and corresponding Consent example XML files.
